23 Jesus said unto him, If thou canst believe, all things are possible to him that believeth. 24 And straightway the father of the child cried out, and said with tears, Lord, I believe; help thou mine unbelief. (Mark 9:23-24 KJV)

This is where Jesus cast a devil out of a young boy, that the disciples could not cast out while Jesus was on the Mount of Transfiguration. Jesus made a marvelous statement here, that if we can believe (have faith), then all things are possible to us. It points out that we have God given power within us, which we can only release when we believe for it, by having faith for it to happen. If we could just realize what power we have in our born again spirits, we could move mountains with it (Matthew 17:20). Most of us don’t have a clue as to what God has put inside the Christian.

Notice that the father of the boy said he believed, but that he also had unbelief. Many Christians don’t believe you can have faith and unbelief at the same time, but you can, and the unbelief will counter-act the faith. We get unbelief from all the things we see and hear in this corrupted world, and we need to not listen to all the unbelief that comes into our homes through television and radio. This world system will fill you full of unbelief and that will cancel out your faith, and cause you to not get the healing, prosperity and deliverance that God’s Grace has brought to us, because you have to have faith only, to receive all that God has provided. We should work on our unbelief, as we already have the faith needed to move mountains in our fruit of the Spirit (Galatians 5:22-23). It is our unbelief that keeps us from being able to do so. Thank God for the fruit of the Spirit and all our blessings.
